lead_with.title: Cost of an Americas FX hub
lead_with.text: A Finance Montréal-commissioned **Boyd Company study (2026)** puts the annual cost of a 150-FTE financial support centre at about **US$18.9M in Montreal vs US$35.3M in New York**, and estimates **c. 51% savings vs New York** with the IFC incentive.

lead_with.title: IFC tax credit built for FX
lead_with.text: Quebec's **International Financial Centre credit** pays **24% of eligible salary, up to $18,000 per employee per year**, for international financial transactions and back-office work done in Montreal (minimum **6 eligible employees** per site).

lead_with.title: Talent in the same time zone as New York
lead_with.text: Finance Montréal cites **120,000+ finance and insurance professionals** and **150,000+ tech specialists**, a bilingual (French/English) workforce, and New York business hours: a fit for serving Santander's **expanded US client base** after Webster.

person.text: **Managing Director and Head of FX for Continental Europe** in Santander CIB's **Risk Solutions Group**, based in **Madrid**. The role covers FX and hedging solutions for corporate and institutional clients across continental Europe. Career history, education and tenure at Santander: **to be confirmed** (LinkedIn profile not publicly readable). He replied quickly to Steve's InMail and redirected to his corporate email: a sign of genuine but formal interest.

company.text: Santander CIB is Banco Santander's wholesale bank, serving **corporates, financial institutions, financial sponsors and institutional clients** with markets (incl. FX), financing, and transaction banking. Group strategy stresses **deeper client relationships, collaboration across the Group and an AI-enabled operating model**. Santander's FX franchise is well recognised: **Euromoney named it Latin America's best FX bank in 2025 and 2026**. In the Americas, the group completed the **US$12.2bn acquisition of Webster Financial** (Stamford, CT) on **Aug 20, 2026**. A Santander CIB presence in **Canada** was not found: **to be confirmed**.

financials.text: **FY2025:** record attributable profit **€14.1bn (+12%)**, total income **€62.4bn**, c. **200,000** employees. **CIB 2025:** revenue **€8.5bn (+5%)**, profit **€2.8bn (+7%)**, constant euros. **9M 2026:** attributable profit **€12,405M (+20%)**, incl. a **€1.9bn** gain on the Poland sale; revenue **€46,807M (+8%)**; underlying RoTE **16.0%**; CET1 **12.7%**; efficiency ratio **42.6%**. **CIB 9M 2026:** underlying profit **€2,433M (+15%)**, revenue **+14%**, RoTE **19.2%**. Buybacks of at least **€10bn** announced against 2025-2026 results.

industry.title: European banks building US/Americas capacity
industry.text: Santander's Webster deal makes it a top-10 US retail and corporate bank by assets, per press reports: more North American clients means more FX and hedging flow to service.

industry.title: Cost pressure on markets businesses
industry.text: Banks keep moving middle/back office and some trading support to lower-cost hubs (Warsaw, Lisbon, Montreal). The Boyd study rates Montreal close to Warsaw on cost vs London, and far cheaper than New York.

industry.title: AI in markets operations
industry.text: Santander lists an **AI-enabled operating model** as a CIB priority; Montreal's AI ecosystem and Finance Montréal's IFC community events on AI-driven cost reduction are a natural link.

talking_points: How does his **Continental Europe FX desk** work with Santander's teams covering **North American clients**, especially since Webster?
Does Santander CIB have, or plan, a **North American hub** for FX sales, structuring, risk or operations? Is **Canada** covered today, and from where?
Would a **bilingual, New York-time-zone team** at about half the New York cost help his business or the wider Risk Solutions Group?
Who in Santander CIB decides on **new locations** (Group strategy, COO, Americas head)? Can Julio introduce Finance Montréal?
Offer a **cost model with the IFC credit** for a sample team (e.g., 20 to 50 FTE) and a **visit to Montreal** to meet BNP Paribas / Société Générale peers already there.

attention.title: Email first, fast.
attention.text: He asked for email; it has been more than a week. Noza should write now, mention Steve's InMail, and propose 2-3 slots (Madrid is 6 hours ahead of Montreal).

attention.title: He is likely not the final decision-maker.
attention.text: A regional FX head can champion the idea but location decisions sit higher. Aim for an **introduction to strategy / operations**, not a commitment.
